recipe.input: 16 RGB frames at 2 fps; aspect-preserving 288x288 letterbox; float32 [0,1]
recipe.pooling: Mean spatial tokens per time step, then mean across pretrained temporal embeddings
recipe.head: Source-balanced logistic regression, fixed C=0.01, fit-fold-only standardization
recipe.positive_fit: One organizer-onset-centered clip per positive fit source
recipe.negative_fit: Six label-blind clips per clean fit source; no inferred negatives from positive sources
recipe.held_and_validation: Label-blind full-source sliding clips, stride 4 seconds, identical aggregation
recipe.calibration: Three training folds; specificity >= 0.75 and recall >= 0.50
recipe.selection: Preserve two baseline positives and all four clean sources; recover at least one previous miss
